tools.name: sump_pump_vs_backwater_valve
tools.description: Compare what a sump pump and backwater valve do, and prepare questions for a basement flood assessment.

tools.name: water_damage_checker
tools.description: Likely water damage category (1, 2 or 3), the mould risk window, first safety steps and what to record for an insurer.

tools.name: mould_size_checker
tools.description: Whether mould patches are a small, medium or large area under Health Canada guidance, and when a professional is recommended.

tools.name: sewage_backup_checker
tools.description: First steps after a sewage backup, health precautions, and which affected items can be cleaned and disinfected or must be thrown away.

tools.name: frozen_pipe_checker
tools.description: Which City of Toronto frozen pipe risk factors apply, what to do tonight, and how to thaw a pipe safely.

tools.name: after_a_fire_checklist
tools.description: A tailored checklist for after a house or building fire: when it is safe to go in, securing the property, food and smoke cautions, and what to record for an insurer.

tools.name: insurance_claim_checklist
tools.description: A tailored checklist of the photos, lists, receipts and records to collect after water, fire or storm damage.

tools.name: dehumidifier_size_calculator
tools.description: Dehumidifier capacity in pints per day for a room or basement, from its floor area and how damp it is, using the ENERGY STAR sizing table.

tools.name: sump_pump_size_calculator
tools.description: Litres per minute of rain that could reach a sump pit from a roof and paved area, using Environment and Climate Change Canada rainfall data for Toronto City or Toronto Pearson.

tools.name: indoor_humidity_target_by_outdoor_temp
tools.description: The highest indoor relative humidity that limits window condensation at a given outdoor temperature, with a check against the Health Canada 30 to 50 per cent range.

tools.name: smoke_alarm_placement_checker
tools.description: Where smoke alarms go in an Ontario home and the least number needed, from the storeys, bedrooms and building type, with maintenance duties for owners and tenants.

tools.name: basement_flooding_subsidy_eligibility
tools.description: Which items of the City of Toronto Basement Flooding Protection Subsidy Program apply to a home, which program conditions are met or need checking, and what to keep for the application. No dollar figures.
